branches.qualification: no benefic association or aspect; malefic occupancy intensifies destruction
benefic in the same position cannot produce the bhava good result

branches.trigger: lord in 6th/8th/12th or lord of one of those houses occupying the bhava
branches.qualification: benefic aspect makes the bhava flourishing

normalized_rule: Phaladeepika gives separate destruction branches: a afflicted lord without benefic support, malefic occupancy of the 6th/8th/12th, or a lord/lord-of-Dussthana occupying the bhava; a benefic aspect qualifies the last branch.
synthesis_notes: This is a Mantreswara/Phaladeepika proposition, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The three source branches and branch-specific qualifications are encoded separately rather than merged into one generic trigger.
